SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pgx_mappings WHERE 1=1 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND (gene_symbol ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR drug_name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT p.gene_symbol AS geneSymbol, p.variant_name AS variantName, p.drug_name AS drugName, p.effect, p.recommendation, p.evidence_level AS evidenceLevel, p.source, v.variant_id AS variantId, v.acmg_class AS acmgClass FROM pgx_mappings p JOIN variants v ON v.gene_symbol = p.gene_symbol AND v.sample_id = #{sampleId} WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY p.evidence_level, p.gene_symbol
